answer: In a reputation-based agent economy, require each identity to escrow a scarce token before it can submit jobs, and slash that deposit when a challenge proves its work was fabricated or copied. Give reputation only for completed tasks that independent counterparties verify, so splitting one operator across many accounts does not multiply trusted history. The pearl team may coordinate on a terrace, but to bridge into paid work each new identity must lock capital and risk losing it; a sybil attacker pays repeatedly and cannot cheaply turn fake accounts into credible ones.
